glosses: soccus (slipper worn by Ancient Greek comedic actors)
plinth (block or slab upon which a column or other structure stands)

examples.text: Tom levou um soco na boca.
examples.en: Tom got punched in the mouth.

examples.text: Você deu um soco no Tom?
O Tom me deu um soco no rosto.
examples.en: Tom punched me in the face.

examples.text: Queria ter dado um soco na cara de Tom.
examples.en: I wish I'd punched Tom in the face.
